Cold storage is a method of keeping crypto assets offline. Cold storage keeps private keys disconnected from the internet. Cold storage reduces the risk of remote hacking compared with hot wallets. Cold storage is commonly implemented with hardware wallets or paper wallets.

Impermanent Loss is a loss that liquidity providers may face in automated market maker pools. Impermanent Loss arises when the price of deposited assets diverges from its value at deposit. Impermanent Loss can be worse than the outcome of simply holding the same assets. Impermanent Loss becomes permanent if liquidity is withdrawn while the divergence persists.

All-Time-Low (ATL) is the lowest price an asset has ever reached. All-Time-Low (ATL) is used to describe a price point in an asset's trading history. All-Time-Low (ATL) is often cited when an asset's value has fallen sharply.

Altcoin is a term for any cryptocurrency other than Bitcoin. Altcoin is generally considered to carry higher risk than Bitcoin. Altcoin is a broad category that includes many newer or smaller tokens.

Black Swan Event is a rare and unpredictable event with severe consequences. Black Swan Event is typically rationalized as predictable only after it occurs. Black Swan Event can cause major losses across markets and the crypto ecosystem.
